results.content: + School of Education and Human Development. Logo: University of Miami (for print). |  | CSC 410 | Lokesh Ramamoorthi | 2-Dec | 5:00 PM | Artica - An app to share summary of articles/research content as a video |  |. Machine learning has enjoyed great success in recent years, and is well suited for mining heuristics from data. Having good representations of logical formulae is a very important prerequisite to using machine learning for finding useful heuristics for ATP. Vector embeddings serve as an ideal representation of logical formulae for processing in machine learning models such as neural networks. Focusing on the flow of information through a molecular interaction network using a network propagation approach, we hypothesized that the difference in the flow of information between control and injured conditions prioritizes relevant driver nodes that cause this state change. We then introduce a new approach to identify controller nodes based on the edges of the network.
